comment: Never-worse ratchet: the gate fails when the problem count is HIGHER than this, and never on errors alone. Was 103 before the 1.0.6 review cleanup. Of the 22 left, 14 are in two files nobody can usefully fix -- 12 in src/kaitai/rmv6-generated.js (machine-generated; hand edits are lost on the next `npm run generate:kaitai`) and 2 in src/shims/setimmediate.ts (a bundle polyfill, where `globalThis` and a bare `setTimeout` are correct and Obsidian's popout-window rules do not apply). The other 11 are in src/main.ts: 8 are the deprecated imperative settings API (`display`, `setWarning`) -- DELIBERATE: the replacement needs Obsidian 1.13.0, which is Catalyst early-access only, so adopting it would restrict the plugin to paying insiders; revisit when 1.13 ships publicly. 1 is `settings-tab/prefer-setting-definitions` on `TaggedSyncSettingTab`, which appeared on 2026-08-09 with the local-model settings and raised this number from 10 -- the SAME 1.13.0 tradeoff seen from the class rather than the call: `getSettingDefinitions()` is the API those 8 warnings point at, so it is one decision, not two, and it lifts when they do. 1 is a `ui/sentence-case` false positive on the feature-voting settings entry, where the anchor text "existing requests" sits mid-sentence and must stay lowercase. 1 is `prefer-file-manager-trash-file` on the `vault.trash(file, true)` that crop cleanup deletes through -- DELIBERATE for the same reason from the other side: `FileManager.trashFile()` needs Obsidian 1.6.6 while manifest.json declares minAppVersion 1.5.7, so calling it trips `no-unsupported-api`, which is an error, and the rule cannot be disabled inline (`eslint-comments/no-restricted-disable`). Raising minAppVersion would drop real users on 1.5.7-1.6.5 to satisfy a style preference; revisit when the floor moves past 1.6.6. It rose from 11 to 13 on 2026-08-09 when the OpenAI-compatible adapter and its Ollama/LM Studio vision probes moved from pro/ into src/ for the free localhost backend (free-localhost-ocr spec §2): both carry a `fetchFn ?? fetch` default, which src/fetch-shim.ts names as one of the two patterns esbuild's inject exists to rewrite -- so the identifier IS requestUrl at run time and the warning describes source, not behaviour. pro/ is not linted, which is why the same two lines cost nothing before the move. Not silenced: eslint-comments/no-restricted-disable forbids disabling no-restricted-globals inline. Lower this number whenever you fix something; nothing forces it down. Re-measure with `node scripts/release-checks.mjs lint --write`.
